item.text: I’ll trace the WPScan ingestion path and its existing tests, record the work checkpoint, then update the mapping and run the relevant tests.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p .codex-role-output && cat > .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'
# Checkpoint

Task: support essential WPScan Enterprise fields in WordPress vulnerability ingestion.

Plan:
1. Locate the WPScan ingestion mapper and its existing tests.
2. Map required fields, retaining input ordering and handling absent/null enrichment safely.
3. Run the relevant existing tests and summarize changes/results.
EOF
pwd && rg --files -g '"'!**/.git/**'"' | head -100 && git status --short"
